parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The enterprise identity, also known as the enterprise ID, is a string that can be obtained from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access link, such as https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】.

parameters.name: pipelineId
parameters.description: The pipeline ID, which can be obtained from the pipeline link, such as https://flow.aliyun.com/pipelines/【PipelineId】/current.
